attempts.equivalence_review: Renamed protect/regulator/processor and MCU_UART_TX/RX preserve all 47 selected components and complete expanded net partitions. INA219 supply remains upstream, every logger load including CH340C is downstream; USB A6/B6 and A7/B7 reach bridge 5/6 and MCU TX/RX cross to bridge RX/TX. All current, clock, shared-bus, header, LED/button and mechanical allocations match.

Typec/guard/controller aliases and MCU_TO_BRIDGE/BRIDGE_TO_MCU labels retain identical electrical connectivity: USB polarity is correct, UART directions cross, CH340 V3/VCC and inactive handshake inputs are downstream, R232 is grounded, and INA219 supply is upstream of the shunt. All 47 component choices and numeric budgets equal the reference.

UPSTREAM_3V3 and sense/supply/processor aliases change labels only. All 47 components and expanded pin partitions match reference, including upstream monitor supply, downstream bridge/logger, USB DP/DN and crossed MCU UART pins. Source 500 mA, rail 150 mA, bridge 20 mA, headers 5/40 mA and all clock/mechanical settings are preserved.
